div.div:
ONE PRIMITIVE, TWO USERS
scan/coordinator.rs is a single-flight dedup primitive that is used
twice: once to dedup concurrent AI reviews of the same artifact, and
once to dedup concurrent plugin runs.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(248, 206, 204), rgb(81, 45, 43)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(184, 84, 80), rgb(215, 129, 126));

div.div:
KNOWN DEFECT
ecosystem/traits.rs declares an Ecosystem trait, but only pypi
implements it. cargo and npm hold concrete upstream clients instead,
so the abstraction is declared and barely exercised. This is a known
defect listed in docs/operations.md.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(248, 206, 204), rgb(81, 45, 43)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(184, 84, 80), rgb(215, 129, 126));

div.div:
WHY policy → ai EXISTS
policy/mod.rs imports crate::ai::collect and crate::ai::prompt to fold
COLLECTOR_VERSION and PROMPT_VERSION into the policy fingerprint. That
is the whole edge: versions only. policy does not run reviews and
does not depend on AI behaviour.
